# Wix Car Rentals Uganda

> Uganda's trusted car rental agency since 2008. Self-drive and guided tours from Kampala. SUVs, 4x4s, pickups and more from $50/day.

Wix Car Rentals is a Kampala-based car rental company offering self-drive and chauffeur-driven vehicles for tourists, business travellers, NGOs, and locals across Uganda. The company has operated since 2008 and serves clients globally through its Akamwesi Complex office in Kampala.

## Business Information

- **Company:** Wix Car Rentals Uganda Ltd
- **Founded:** 2008
- **Location:** Akamwesi Complex, 3rd Floor, Office 30, Kampala, Uganda
- **Phone:** +256 393 265 377 / +256 772 350 700
- **WhatsApp:** +256 785 314 156
- **Email:** info@wixcarrentals.com
- **Website:** https://wix-car-rental-try4.vercel.app
- **Operating hours:** Monday–Saturday, 8:00am–5:00pm. Closed Sundays and public holidays.

## Fleet

All vehicles include air conditioning, full tank, luggage capacity, and comprehensive insurance. Unlimited mileage on all rentals.

- **Toyota Prado** — Premium class, 7 seats, automatic, gasoline. $145/day
- **Toyota Hilux** — Pickup class, 5 seats, automatic, gasoline. $120/day
- **Hyundai Santa Fe** — SUV class, 5 seats, automatic, gasoline. $100/day
- **Hyundai Tucson** — Crossover class, 5 seats, automatic, gasoline. $85/day
- **Hyundai Sonata** — Large class, 5 seats, automatic, gasoline. $55/day
- **Hyundai Elantra** — Medium class, 5 seats, automatic, gasoline. $50/day

Optional professional driver available on any vehicle for +$30/day.

## Services

- **Self Drive** — Vehicles rented without a driver. Road maps and 24/7 phone support included.
- **Airport Transfers** — Pickups and drop-offs at Entebbe International Airport. Meet-and-greet available.
- **Chauffeur / Driver Service** — Professional vetted drivers for business travel, weddings, and tours.
- **Safari & Game Park** — 4x4 vehicles for Bwindi, Queen Elizabeth, Murchison Falls, and other parks.
- **Corporate Rental** — Fleet management, invoicing, and priority bookings for NGOs, embassies, and enterprises via the Enterprise Friendly-Rent program.
- **Long-Term Leasing** — Weekly and monthly rates for extended projects and long-term assignments.

## Booking Process

1. Choose a vehicle class from the fleet
2. Fill in travel dates, pick-up location, and contact details
3. Receive instant email confirmation
4. Team follows up within 12 hours to finalise
5. Collect vehicle fully fuelled and insured at the agreed location

Pick-up locations: Entebbe International Airport, Kampala City Centre, Akamwesi Complex Office.

## Key Policies

- No payment required at booking stage
- Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup
- Comprehensive insurance included on all vehicles
- Unlimited mileage on all rentals
- No hidden charges — transparent all-inclusive pricing
- 24/7 roadside assistance
